# Customer Data Handling Standard

Northstar Works is fictional. Use only approved systems to access customer
information, and share the minimum necessary data with authorized recipients.
Do not paste customer records, credentials, or access tokens into public
services or unapproved AI tools.

Report a suspected exposure to the fictional Security Response team using the
internal incident process. This sample is not a substitute for an approved
organizational policy.
